description: This is a Zephyr RTOS-based C source file implementing a CAN bus counter and LED control sample with threading, message queues, and CAN state monitoring.

methods.name: tx_irq_callback
methods.description: Callback function for CAN transmission IRQ, logs errors.

methods.name: rx_thread
methods.description: Thread function to receive CAN messages with specific filter, processes counter messages.

methods.name: change_led_work_handler
methods.description: Handles messages from the LED message queue, updates LED state.

methods.name: state_to_str
methods.description: Converts CAN state enum to string.

methods.name: poll_state_thread
methods.description: Thread to poll CAN controller state and error counts, logs changes.

methods.name: state_change_work_handler
methods.description: Handles CAN state change events, attempts recovery if bus-off.

methods.name: state_change_callback
methods.description: Callback invoked on CAN state change, updates current state and error counts.

methods.name: main
methods.description: Initializes CAN device, threads, message queues, and runs main loop sending CAN messages.
